name: China National Chemical Engineering Co., Ltd
summary: China National Chemical Engineering Co., Ltd. is a leading industrial engineering firm specializing in general contracting for construction, infrastructure, and international projects. Its operations extend across diverse sectors including chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, power, and coal industries, serving clients predominantly in China but also on overseas ventures. The company's service portfolio is comprehensive, covering the entire project lifecycle from initial consulting, geological prospecting, and design, to construction execution, project management, and environmental solutions. Additionally, it drives technological advancement through research, development, and industrialization, alongside providing installation services for pipelines, electrical systems, and complete equipment. Further diversifying its business, the firm engages in import and export trade, real estate development, and the investment and management of industrial plants and infrastructure. Established in Beijing, China, in 1953, China National Chemical Engineering Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China National Chemical Engineering Group Corporation Ltd.
